name: Perl
note: Text-processing scripting language, sometimes called 'the duct tape of the internet'
typeSystem: Dynamic, weakly typed with context-sensitive coercion between strings and numbers, and three distinct sigil-marked variable kinds (scalars $, arrays @, hashes %); references let these compose into arbitrarily nested data structures.
runtime: Compiled to an internal op tree by the Perl interpreter each time a program runs, then walked and executed; there is no separate ahead-of-time compilation step for ordinary scripts.

runtimes.name: perl (reference interpreter)
runtimes.role: Parses source into an internal op tree threaded in execution order and executes it directly.

compilers.name: perl
compilers.role: The reference implementation and compiler/interpreter for Perl programs.

concurrencyModel: Native OS threads (the threads module) with explicit data sharing, though most idiomatic Perl concurrency instead uses forked processes or event loops (e.g. AnyEvent, IO::Async).
